Resident Evil 6 (2012), Complete PC Route

Spoiler-free total completion of every campaign rank and collectible, all records, skills, titles, extra modes, PC crossover content, persistent RE.NET entries, and hidden interactions · 33 areas · 1985 tracked items

This page shows everything, including exact locations. It exists so you can search for one specific collectible and find it. If you are playing blind, use the interactive spoiler-free version instead, it hides locations until you ask for them, one item at a time.

Open the spoiler-free interactive guide

Route and Profile Setup

You are here when: Steam's DLC manager, the main menu, and the online-options screen.

The chosen route is Windows PC with every mode DLC and the PC-only crossover installed.

Install the Complete PC Route

Setup

HintStart by making every permanent mode available from one installation.
WhereInstall Resident Evil 6 and all four Extra Content mode packages through Steam.
Full detailOpen Steam's DLC panel, enable Survivors, Predator, Onslaught, and Siege, finish all updates, then launch once and confirm each appears under Extra Content.

Enable the PC Crossover

Setup

HintOne branch of No Mercy belongs only to the Windows route.
WhereConfirm the Left 4 Dead 2 character set appears in Mercenaries No Mercy.
Full detailStart No Mercy on PC, open character selection, and verify Coach, Ellis, Nick, and Rochelle are selectable; the crossover does not exist in the original console releases.

Link RESIDENT EVIL.NET

Setup

HintSeveral persistent rewards live outside the local menus.
WhereConnect the PC save to RESIDENT EVIL.NET and enable automatic data upload.
Full detailSign in on Capcom's portal, link the Steam game data, enable Auto Data Upload in the game options, complete one short run, and wait until the portal reflects the new record.

Create a Clean Profile Backup

Setup

HintA clean copy makes long record and unlock grinds recoverable.
WhereClose the game and back up the untouched local profile before beginning the campaigns.
Full detailExit fully before copying the save with your normal backup method, restore-test that copy separately, then retain dated snapshots after each campaign and major online unlock batch.

Use Text-Only Guidance

Guide Rule

HintThere is no owned gameplay footage for this game yet.
WhereThis pack intentionally contains no screenshots, maps, or generated sketches.
Full detailUse the physical cues in the text. Add optional visuals only after Sami's own recording can provide a provenance-tracked frame for the exact item.

Skills and Weapon Mastery

You are here when: The Skill Settings and Records panels beside campaign selection.

Every unique purchasable skill is listed once even when several modes share it.

Agent Hunt

You are here when: The Agent Hunt tile under Extra Content and its creature-skill screen.

Creature identities that could disclose later encounters remain hidden behind numbered medal entries.

Complete Agent Hunt Once

Mode Completion

HintLearn both movement and attack recovery before chasing rare forms.
WhereEnter another player's compatible campaign as a creature and finish the session.
Full detailChoose Agent Hunt, accept a compatible session, play the assigned creature until the host clears or is defeated, and remain through results so the mode record and first medals register.

Participate in Every Current Event Type (missable)

Live Event

HintThe portal rotates competitive and cooperative tasks on a published calendar.
WhereCheck the Windows RE6 event page before every play session and enter each active format.
Full detailRead the active event's date window and scoring rule on RE.NET, upload qualifying PC data before its deadline, then claim every participation reward. Historical placements cannot be recreated; only current and future rotations are honestly attainable.

Secret Interactions

You are here when: Optional scenery marked by a magnifying-glass prompt, playground equipment, instruments, or loose props.

These interactions award no completion record but are included because they are deliberate hidden content.

Detached-Hand Microwave

Secret Interaction

HintOptional interaction prompts reward close inspection of ordinary scenery.
WhereIn Chris or Leon Chapter 4, look for a detached hand near the microwave.
Full detailReach Chris or Leon Chapter 4 and damage a hand-bearing enemy until one hand separates. Do not destroy it: let it leap toward you, or pick it up while standing beside the microwave. The contextual action places it inside and triggers the hidden animation.

Detached-Hand Toilet

Secret Interaction

HintOptional interaction prompts reward close inspection of ordinary scenery.
WhereIn room containing usable toilet, look for a detached hand near the toilet.
Full detailReach room containing usable toilet and damage a hand-bearing enemy until one hand separates. Do not destroy it: let it leap toward you, or pick it up while standing beside the toilet. The contextual action places it inside and triggers the hidden animation.

Secret Interaction

HintOptional interaction prompts reward close inspection of ordinary scenery.
WhereIn room containing boiling oil drum, look for a detached hand near the boiling oil drum.

Detached-Hand Oven

Secret Interaction

HintOptional interaction prompts reward close inspection of ordinary scenery.
WhereIn room containing flaming oven, look for a detached hand near the flaming oven.
Full detailReach room containing flaming oven and damage a hand-bearing enemy until one hand separates. Do not destroy it: let it leap toward you, or pick it up while standing beside the flaming oven. The contextual action places it inside and triggers the hidden animation.
